title: Shiver — Cold-shower timer and gradual plans
description: Start warm and finish cold with a hands-free shower timer, a free 14-day starter plan, session logs, and a weekly rhythm with room to rest.
headline:
A cold finish.
At your own pace.
intro: Shiver is for an ordinary shower, not an ice bath. Start warm, follow a gradual cold finish, and let a large timer, haptics, and chimes mark each change. Rest days belong in the routine, too.
tagline: Start warm. Finish cold. Keep room for rest.
cardHeadline: A hands-free cold-shower timer, with graduated plans and room for rest days.
purchaseNote: Shiver Pro is an optional auto-renewing subscription. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings at least 24 hours before renewal.

steps.title: Begin with the starter plan
steps.text: The free 14-Day Starter grows a cold finish from 15 to 90 seconds over two weeks. Read the safety guidance before deciding whether to begin.

steps.title: Let the timer guide the phases
steps.text: Choose a get-ready countdown, then follow warm and cold phases with haptics and a chime. Stop whenever you need to; a longer shower is not a better score.

steps.title: Log the session and find a rhythm
steps.text: Completed sessions record duration, cold time, and plan day. Add mood and a cold rating, choose a weekly session goal, and use Rest Mode when you need a break.

features.title: A timer made for the shower
features.text: Large controls, phase cues, and one free timer preset keep the session simple. Optional post-target timing records extra elapsed time only; it earns no streak, badge, or plan credit.

features.title: Progress without competing
features.text: Review your calendar heatmap, sessions, and 18 visible milestones against your own history. Rest days never count as completed sessions.

features.title: A backup you control
features.text: Manually save sessions, notes, plans, presets, and selected settings as a plaintext JSON file. Restore it from a destination you choose.

included: 14-Day Starter plan, hands-free timer, and session log
One timer preset, weekly rhythm goal, Rest Mode, and safety skip
Session deletion and manual JSON backup and restore
premium: Five additional plans, including Contrast Protocol and The Reset
Full statistics, retro-logging and streak repair, CSV export, and unlimited timer presets
Seated, silent breathing preparation before the shower—not during it
Separate Apple Health opt-ins for mindful minutes or a nonmedical recovery nudge
Optional on-device voice commands, enabled for each foreground session
privacy: Your session history and notes are stored on your device. A manual backup is plaintext: keep the file somewhere private.
Purchases and entitlement checks use Apple and RevenueCat. App updates use Expo; local activity storage does not mean the app never connects to the internet.
Health access and foreground voice commands are optional; touch controls remain available.
limitations: Cold exposure is a physiological stressor. Read the safety guidance, stop if you feel unwell, and ask a qualified healthcare professional first if you have any concern about suitability.
Shiver is a habit and timer tool, not a medical device or treatment. It does not measure water temperature or turn a shower into a cold plunge.
Breathing preparation is seated and outside the shower. Extra time after a target is not an instruction to stay cold longer.
